description: Connect your Pixelixe account to find saved documents, inspect a design, create a new graphic from scratch, or generate a new variant from an existing document. Pixelixe is useful for social posts, promos, event graphics, and other reusable marketing visuals. New outputs are saved to your Pixelixe workspace so you can open them in Studio and keep editing.
